doctorate.institution: Rutgers, The State University of New Jersey
doctorate.title: The Perils and Pleasures of the City: Single, Wage-Earning Women in Toronto, 1880-1930

evidence.says: ANU identifies Carolyn Strange in its School of History, records her teaching and graduate leadership at the University of Toronto, and lists a PhD in U.S. and women’s history from Rutgers.

Her self-reported education lists a Rutgers PhD in U.S. History/Women’s History ending in May 1991. Employment includes University of Toronto appointments in Criminology and History, followed by ANU History.

The bibliography Recent Publications in Canadian Labour History, PDF page 25, lists Carolyn Edith Strange’s dissertation with the same title as the linked record, identifying it as a Rutgers PhD thesis dated 1991.

notes: The institution, author and dissertation title match the linked record. Its 1992 date differs from the 1991 thesis date in the scholarly bibliography and the May 1991 completion reported on ORCID; the reason for this discrepancy was not established.
